def countWords (text : String) : HashMap String Nat := Id.run do
  let mut counts : HashMap String Nat := {}
  for word in text.splitOn " " do
    unless word.isEmpty do
      counts := counts.insert word (counts.getD word 0 + 1)
  return counts
